comments.story: Attitudes That Lead to Maintainable Code
comments.why: Offered as a monad explanation for a confused asker
comments.text: A nomad is something that goes "nom!" ;) A monad is basically an function, in the algebra sense, that will take a set of input, and map it to a different output. That's the most simple definition I can give without getting into the math, and it's been a minute since I've really gotten into Group theory. Maybe through a Haskell tutorial for some hands-on guidance? [LINK] [VIDEO]
